description: Global - Roads Open Access Data Set is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Transport", published or maintained by Socioeconomic Data and Applications Center (sedac) (Columbia University Earth Institute). The Global Roads Open Access Data Set, Version 1 (gROADSv1) was developed under the auspices of the CODATA Global Roads Data Development Task Group. The data set combines the best available roads data by country into a global roads coverage, using the UN Spatial Data Infrastructure Transport (UNSDI-T) version 2 as a common data model. Coverage: Sub-Saharan Africa, the Middle East and North Africa. It has 3 files in GeoJSON, ZIP, PDF. The portal files it under Transport. The portal gives 2010 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC0-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
